title: Automatic calibration with BT meter and manual calibration dialog
symptom: When using a Contour Next One BT meter with automatic calibration enabled, sometimes the message 'Use this measurement for calibration?' appears immediately after a measurement, instead of waiting 15 minutes. If 'No' is selected, automatic calibration still works. Additionally, when starting a new Libre sensor, xDrip asks for two calibration values, but the BT meter value overrides the dialog and is not used for initial calibration.
cause: The issue occurs when the xDrip calibration dialog is shown and a BT meter value is received, which overrides the dialog and prevents the value from being used for initial calibration.
evidence_quote: But when the xDrip dialog is shown and you use the BT meter, then this dialog is overridden with the "received new BT value" one. This value is not used for initial calibration.
